name: Timeline
tagline: A personal career timeline and projects page, with an optional explorable 3D diorama.
description: Victor Neves' timeline: a semantic 2D page of career milestones and open-source projects, plus an optional low-poly 3D world to explore.
features: Semantic 2D timeline that works without JavaScript.
Optional 3D diorama built with three.js, loaded only on request.
Light and dark theme, self-hosted fonts and service worker caching.
